name: kb_559_Normalized

schema.description: MetricTarget defines the target value, average value, or average utilization of a specific metric

averageUtilization.description: averageUtilization is the target value of the average of the resource metric across all relevant pods, represented as a percentage of the requested value of the resource for the pods. Currently only valid for Resource metric source type

averageValue.description: averageValue is the target value of the average of the metric across all relevant pods (as a quantity)

type.description: type represents whether the metric type is Utilization, Value, or AverageValue

value.description: value is the target value of the metric (as a quantity).

description: The configured metric target is of type **Utilization**. It specifies that the average utilization across the relevant pods should be maintained at **75 %** of the requested resource amount. In addition, the target includes an average value of **250 m** (millis) for the metric when aggregated across all pods, and an absolute target value of **1** unit. This combination of utilization, average value, and absolute value defines the thresholds that the autoscaler will use to determine scaling actions.
